name: SimplifyJobs — New Grad Positions
coverage_note: Curated/index-verified Canadian rows only, not employer-verified. Explicit closed records are retained with is_closed=true for reconciliation, never as open inventory. Active flags can lag closures. Simplify date_posted is retained as index_posted_at, not an employer posting date.
maintenance_note: The current dev branch contains new-grad positions across hiring years; no 2026/2027 title filter is imposed. Review repository/default branch on schema errors and at each recruiting-season rollover.

name: SimplifyJobs — 2026/2027 internships and off-season
coverage_note: Complete current JSON index, Canadian visible openings plus explicit closed records retained with is_closed=true for reconciliation, never as open inventory. Includes summer and off-season 2026/2027 terms plus other explicitly listed terms; not limited to README.md. Curator availability is not employer verification; past work terms may remain marked active.
maintenance_note: Named Summer2027 repository may be renamed each season; check GitHub canonical repository and default branch on 404 and each January/July. .github/scripts/listings.json includes README-Off-Season.md entries; preserve terms and do not infer deadlines or invent a year.

name: Frogg — Canadian Internships
coverage_note: Curated Canadian internships/co-ops. date_posted is feed-reported, not employer-verified; date_found is separate. Work terms are never deadlines. Explicit closed records are retained with is_closed=true for reconciliation, never as open inventory.
maintenance_note: Unversioned feed dynamically changes across 2026/2027 terms; no fixed year filter. Monitor schema and source activity; archive.json is not treated as open inventory.

name: LinkedIn public — software, internship/entry-level
coverage_note: LIMITED public sample: at most 3 pages, Canadian location + LinkedIn f_E=1,2 + last 30 days; only 5 descriptions enriched. Guest pages have variable size and no complete total. Index seniority can be wrong; not all LinkedIn jobs and not employer verification. Cap/rate-limit/login/schema failures are explicit with partial_jobs. No cookies/accounts/challenge bypass.

name: LinkedIn public — new grad
coverage_note: LIMITED explicit new-grad query, 3 guest pages + 5 details, f_E=1,2, last 30 days. No year restriction, so 2026 and 2027 hiring can appear. Index labels require employer eligibility checks. Partial/failure status must remain visible; no account or cookies.

name: LinkedIn public — embedded/firmware entry-level
coverage_note: LIMITED 3-page embedded search, 5 descriptions, Canada + internship/entry filters, last 30 days. Prioritizes embedded/space-related discovery but does not establish citizenship, clearance or new-grad eligibility. Partial listings survive explicit cap exceptions.

name: LinkedIn public — MDA Space early-career search
coverage_note: LIMITED public keyword search: MDA Space, Canada, internship/entry-level, newest 30 days; 2 pages and 5 descriptions. Individual cards supply actual employer names. Not direct UKG coverage and not all MDA vacancies; citizenship/clearance/student restrictions require employer verification.

name: LinkedIn public — data analyst entry-level
coverage_note: LIMITED 2-page public search + 3 details; Canada, internship/entry-level, last 30 days. Public index only, no comprehensive LinkedIn access.

name: LinkedIn public — IT support entry-level
coverage_note: LIMITED 2-page public search + 3 details; Canada, internship/entry-level, last 30 days. Support and infrastructure jobs included, not just internships. Public index labels need employer verification.

name: LinkedIn public — cybersecurity entry-level
coverage_note: LIMITED 2-page guest search + 3 details; Canada and internship/entry-level, last 30 days. No complete public total; rate limits/challenges are surfaced, never bypassed.

name: Job Bank Canada — software
coverage_note: LIMITED newest 2 public search pages; first 50 details. No experience assumption from search alone; description-based filtering belongs to the core. Explicit Advertised until values are genuine board deadlines. Job Bank includes third-party indexed advertisements, not all postings are verified employers.

name: Job Bank Canada — data analyst
coverage_note: LIMITED newest 2 public pages with 50 detail enrichments. Query is not an experience filter. Board datePosted and explicit Advertised until only; no inferred closing dates.

name: Job Bank Canada — computer support
coverage_note: LIMITED newest 2 public search pages + 50 details. Broad IT/helpdesk source; core must inspect experience and Canadian location. Partial count and any detail failures remain visible.

name: The Muse — early-career searches
coverage_note: Public documented API, no key required at this request rate. Up to 25 pages; declared total/page_count checked. Muse location filters also return US-only/unspecified remote jobs: only actual explicit Canadian listing locations qualify, never the search parameter alone. Selected-city/index coverage, not all Canadian jobs.

name: Remotive — remote roles
coverage_note: Public feed across categories, delayed by 24 hours; many senior roles will be rejected by the core. Worldwide/unspecified remote is not assumed Canada-eligible. Preserve Remotive attribution and listing URLs; private personal use only, no signup wall or re-syndication to third-party boards.
maintenance_note: Twice-daily refresh is within Remotive's recommendation of at most four API requests per day. Do not split into per-category polling or repeatedly probe during normal operations.

name: Remote OK — remote roles
coverage_note: LIMITED public latest-job feed (observed 99 jobs plus one metadata row), not the complete board; no public history pagination used. Actual Canada location required; global remote not assumed eligible. Preserve Remote OK attribution and listing URL as required by its API terms.

name: Arbeitnow — location supplement (Europe-focused)
disabled_reason: Public endpoint works but its first 300-job page contained no explicit Canadian locations; Europe-focused and not useful as primary Canada coverage. Adapter is implemented/tested, not scheduled by default.
coverage_note: NOT scheduled by default. One-page feasibility sample only, next page exists; zero Canada matches in that sample does not mean the entire board has none. Remote=true never implies Canada eligibility. Preserve Arbeitnow attribution.

name: CAE — Canadian software roles (Workday)
coverage_note: Employer-verified public Workday CXS, Canada country facet discovered from current response, software full-text query. Includes non-intern/graduate/regular roles for core filtering. Up to 15x20 index rows and 150 details; caps are explicit, never complete-board claims.

name: CAE — Canadian student roles (Workday)
coverage_note: Employer public Canadian Student category discovered dynamically. Full detail eligibility retained, including school enrolment, work-term dates, controlled-goods/security requirements; no assumption that a graduating student qualifies.

name: RBC — Canadian early talent (Workday)
coverage_note: Employer-verified early-talent board, actual Canada facet, not all RBC roles. Preserves returning-to-school caveats. For explicit Application Deadline with a day-prior note, the actual previous-day closing date is used with both pieces of source evidence; no presumed deadlines.

name: RBC — Canadian graduate search (Workday)
coverage_note: Employer-verified general-board graduate full-text query; supports new-grads rather than only co-op enrolment. Senior roles mentioning graduate credentials may appear and must be filtered by the core. Explicit index/detail caps reported.

name: CIBC — Canadian campus/rotational programs (Workday)
coverage_note: Employer-verified campus board, dynamically discovered Canada facet. Covers internships and rotational/regular early-career positions; not all CIBC jobs. Enrollment requirements remain in descriptions. Relative postedOn strings are not fabricated into dates.

name: Bombardier — direct early-career technical postings
coverage_note: Direct public sitemap discovery, English internship/junior/graduate technical-title URLs only, at most 50 details. Fetches employer JobPosting JSON-LD where present; current Bombardier pages instead expose schema.org JobPosting microdata and explicit Posting Start Date. Sitemap lastmod is NOT a job date/deadline. International locations are filtered using actual posting location. Bombardier uses SAP, not Workday. Not the entire employer board.
maintenance_note: Dynamic current sitemap avoids fixed 2026/2027 job URLs. Current legacy /16088-en_US URLs and the search page did not expose JobPosting JSON-LD; canonical sitemap job URLs have real title/description microdata. Parse only published dates; missing deadline remains null. Students-only restrictions are retained.
